newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 edges higher at fixing.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 edges higher at fixing.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rose slightly at Monday's fixing on the Prague bourse, with major issues mixed, many shares unchanged and all eyes focused on a confidence vote in the centre-right government on Tuesday.
Traders said that if the government loses the vote the Prague bourse could be hit by another wave of uncertainty and bearish sentiment.
"I don't think it would be viewed (by the market) as good...it will bring uncertainty to the market," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.

Most analysts expect the government to win the vote but it must first sort out a disagreement among coalition parties on the 1997 state budget. Discussion on cuts to the budget are going on throughout the day.
Dealers said major issues were mixed in response to the uncertainty.
SPT Telecom fell 15 crowns to 3,180, CEZ rose two crowns to 900, Komercni Banka gained 45 crowns to 1,990 and Ceska Sporitelna was unchanged on 292.
